THE GRADE IS THE OWNER'S RATIFIED LADDER OF 2026-09-03 (G1a), applied to every identity at once by tools/consolidate_resident_evidence.py and spent onto this card by tools/mint_civic_residents.py; the evidence blocks below carry the reading AS READ, its locator and the record it came from, so the page can be gone back to. Moses and Kirkland, History of Chicago, Illinois, vol. 1 (1895), printed page 90 (claim bk_mose1_005; data/research/books/claims/moses_kirkland_history_of_chicago_v1.json): "Among the new arrivals in the spring of 1833 are the names of John Dean Caton, John K. Botsford, Silas B. Cobb, Charles Cleaver, Walter Kimball, H. W. Knickerbocker, Ezekiel Morrison, Asahel Pierce, Hibbard Porter, Stephen Rexford, Henry Whitehead, Eli B. Williams, Dr. John T. Temple, Rev. Jeremiah Porter and Rev. Allan B. Freeman."
